name: nyc-taxi-data-science-project
description: End-to-End NYC Taxi Machine Learning Trip Duration & Fare System

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000', { cwd: 'server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm run dev', { cwd: 'client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run build:client
